title: Build our own bookmarking app under the Unbody brand
context: Allows us to experiment with tech and learn from real users. Not just a side project — a laboratory.

title: Mindloops — another app name idea: Untangle
context: Names keep changing. The core idea: help people untangle the mess of things they save and think about.

title: AI as mental prosthetic for ADHD
context: Where the term 'cognitive exoskeleton' was coined — AI that extends executive function, not replaces it. The tool should think WITH you.

title: Untangle elevator pitch and name origin
context: Trying to articulate what this tool IS — not a bookmark manager, not a note app. A thinking partner that understands what you care about.

title: The Tools We Think With
context: How writing, maps, and software shape cognition — not just augment it. Tools don't just help us think, they change HOW we think.

title: Notion vs Obsidian vs Roam — PKM tool comparison
context: Evaluating existing tools. None of them understand the user. They organize content but don't understand why you saved it.

title: Andy Matuschak — Why books don't work
context: Reading is not understanding. Passive consumption creates illusion of learning. You need active engagement — spaced repetition, elaboration.

title: logseq
context: Open source knowledge base with outliner and graph view. Interesting approach but still user-driven organization.

title: Vannevar Bush — As We May Think
context: The 1945 essay that predicted hypertext and personal knowledge systems. The 'memex' — a device for storing and linking everything you read.

title: What if your bookmark manager could tell you what you're obsessed with?
context: The insight: most tools help you FIND things. What if the tool helped you UNDERSTAND yourself through what you save?
